question.text: The maximum timeline under SEBI PM Regs for grievance redressal is:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI PM Regs: grievance must be resolved within 21 calendar days. Unresolved grievances escalate to SCORES or ODR. The Trap: 7 days too aggressive; 30/90 too lax. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A Topic 9 covers; XXI-B tests. Manager's Pro-Tip: Track grievances in an aging report — quarterly SEBI filings include grievance resolution metrics.
